title: Fuzzy Wurm Crawler
move_pattern: Cycles: Acid Goop → Inhale → Acid Goop (repeats). First action uses FIRST_ACID_GOOP which is mechanically identical to ACID_GOOP.
notes: The Inhale move inflates the monster (IsPuffed state), changing its animation to an idle_loop_puffed animation. Acid Goop deflates it back to the normal idle_loop animation. This is purely cosmetic but changes how the monster appears during combat based on its most recent move.
